# Pathogen
Nobody knows what they are. The [bold]Pathogen[/bold] creatures have never been documented. Every encounter is, as far as anyone knows, the first, and whoever survives one is facing something no one has seen before.
What little survivors describe is a living fungal infestation: creatures grown from mycelium and spores, spreading through a colony like a disease.
## The Confluence - The creatures belong to the [bold]Mycelial Confluence[/bold], a single organism made of many bodies. Each one is a manifestation of the Confluence's will, and their only task is to spread it until it covers everything they can reach. - They are led by the [bold]Overmind[/bold], a mind bound to the Confluence through a [bold]Blight Core[/bold]. Without a core to anchor it, the Overmind withers away. - The creatures share thoughts through the [bold]Mycelial Link[/bold], and speak among themselves in a wet, clicking language carried on spores. - They carpet the ground in [bold]blight[/bold], a living mycelium that feeds and heals them, and raise towers that fill the air with spores and choking fog.
## Infection - The Confluence spreads through [bold]spores[/bold]. Sacs and growths release them onto anyone who wanders too close, and they can get past an ordinary gas mask. Only fully sealed protective gear keeps them out. - Infected hosts are taken to the nest, where a [bold]bloodburster[/bold] grows inside them and eventually tears its way out, then matures into a larger creature. - Even death is no escape. Its mycotoxin can rewrite a corpse's nervous system and raise it again as a [bold]walker[/bold], bound to serve the Overmind. - On rare occasions, a creature born from a [textlink="Yautja" link="CMUGuideLoreHunters"] host becomes a horrific hybrid aberration.
